This is a basic, reliable '''banana bread''' recipe. The perfect thing to do with over-ripe bananas! An alternative version of this recipe can be found [[Cookbook:Banana bread II|here]].

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|350°F (175°C)]]. 
# Lightly grease an 8 x 4-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (20 x 10 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) [[cookbook:loaf pan|loaf pan]].
# Combine all ingredients into a large [[cookbook:mixing bowl|mixing bowl]]. Beat well.
# Pour batter into pan.
# [[cookbook:Bake|Bake]] on middle shelf of oven for 60 minutes, or until a [[Cookbook:Toothpick|toothpick]] inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean.  

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]] and ⅓ cup milk can be substituted for the sour milk/buttermilk and baking soda.
* ½ cup nuts may also be added to the mixture
